data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): T12 add tests for (a) item failing one rule but passing other two appears in deviations; (b) 95% threshold uses item-level AND-ed pass over total items; (c) exit non-zero iff pass_rate<0.95; (d) stable summary line format including pass_rate, total_items, deviations_count for downstream story 5003-75a8.
